title: What It Actually Looks Like to Want a Wife and Not Need One
caption:
You can want a wife and still not need one. Those aren't the same thing, even though they feel identical at 11 PM scrolling through someone's profile.

Need turns her into an exit from being alone with God. Want lets her be exactly what she is: a gift, not a rescue.

Build the life you'd still want if she never came. That's the life worth her joining.

Seek first the kingdom. Everything else gets added, not chased.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #singleness #contentment
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
